How it works

Estimate a vehicle's future value using an annual depreciation rate. Use the units shown in the calculator and review every assumption before using the result.

Formula

Future value = current value × (1 − annual depreciation rate)^years.

Worked example

A $35,000 car depreciating at 15% per year for 4 years is worth about $18,267 under this simplified model.

Important assumptions

This tool is designed for planning and comparison. Real-world prices, manufacturer ratings, building requirements, lender terms, electrical codes, tolerances, and product specifications can vary.

Frequently asked questions

Is this calculator free?

Yes. It runs in your browser and does not require an account.

Are the results exact?

The math is deterministic for the entered values, but the result depends on inputs and assumptions. Verify safety-critical, financial, code-related, towing, fitment, and manufacturer-specific decisions with authoritative information.
